transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.text: Help! My mom was cooking fries and the pan suddenly burst into flames! The fire is getting big!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My brother threw a burning piece of paper in the trash can in his bedroom and now the trash is on fire!

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My brother put a toaster pastry in the toaster and didn't take it out, and now the toaster is on fire!

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! I lit a candle in my bedroom and it fell over, now my homework and desk are on fire!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! I put a fork in the microwave by accident and now it's making crazy sparks and smoke is coming out!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! My mom left the iron on the ironing board and now the board is on fire!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! We made a campfire in our backyard but the wind blew some sparks into the dry grass and now the grass is on fire!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My space heater got too close to my blanket and now the blanket is on fire in my room!

transcript.speaker: Caller

911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! I was doing laundry and I think the dryer lint caught on fire. There is smoke coming out of the dryer!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! The lights on our Christmas tree started sparking and now the whole tree is on fire!

transcript.speaker: Caller

transcript.speaker: Caller

transcript.speaker: Caller

scenarios.title: Suspicious Person in Backyard
scenarios.location: Municipal Hall Annex, Brgy. Poblacion I

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello? I need help. I just saw someone jump over our fence and they are hiding in our backyard.

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! Someone is jiggling the handle on my front door trying to get in!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! Someone is in my driveway right now trying to cut the lock off my bicycle!

scenarios.title: Vandalism In Progress
scenarios.location: Town Plaza Alley, Brgy. Poblacion III

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! There are teenagers outside spray painting our community center's front wall!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! There is a huge stray dog in my front yard growling and snapping at anyone who walks by!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! I am driving and a guy in a red truck is following me and trying to run me off the road!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello, I am at the city park and someone just dropped a heavy black backpack by the playground and ran away.
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello, my neighbors are having a massive screaming match. It sounds like they are throwing things and someone is crying.

scenarios.title: Car Break-In at Night
scenarios.location: Municipal Hall Annex, Brgy. Poblacion I

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello, I'm looking out my window and there's a guy breaking into my neighbor's car across the street!

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help, I'm the manager at the corner store! A guy just shoved past me with a basket full of stolen electronics!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! My brother ate a peanut butter cookie and he is highly allergic! His face is swelling up!

scenarios.title: Elderly Fall Down Stairs

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.text: Help! My grandfather just fell down the entire flight of stairs and he's groaning on the floor!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! My husband was eating steak and now he's clutching his throat! He can't breathe!

scenarios.title: Severe Asthma Attack
scenarios.location: Bus Terminal Loading Bay, Brgy. Bubukal

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help, my daughter is having a severe asthma attack! She can barely breathe!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! I was chopping vegetables and the knife slipped! I cut my hand deeply and it's bleeding everywhere!

scenarios.title: Heart Attack Symptoms
scenarios.location: Barangay San Juan (Near the health center)

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! My father says his chest is being crushed and pain is shooting down his left arm!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! A pot of boiling water just fell off the stove all over my legs! The skin is peeling!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! My friend was just stung by a bee in the park! His face is swelling up and he says he can't breathe!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! My wife is acting very strangely! The left side of her face looks droopy and she can't speak clearly!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help, I'm a teacher at the elementary school! One of my students is having a severe asthma attack on the playground!

scenarios.title: Car Hit a Power Pole and Caught Fire
scenarios.location: Town Plaza Alley, Brgy. Poblacion III

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! A car just swerved off the road and smashed into a power pole! The front of the car is on fire!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! A black sedan just ran a red light, hit a man in the crosswalk, and sped away without stopping!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! My neighbor's husband just hit her in the front yard, and now he is pouring gasoline on her porch!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! A guy just broke my living room window to get inside, but he slipped and cut his leg really badly on the glass!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! Our stove caught on fire and my husband collapsed holding his chest!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My brother left a burning mosquito coil on top of a plastic stool and now the stool is melting and catching fire!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello? The electric fan in my room is making a loud buzzing sound and black smoke is coming out of the back motor! It smells like burnt rubber!

scenarios.title: Phone Charger Bed Fire
scenarios.location: P. Burgos Street, Brgy. Poblacion I

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Please help! I left my phone charging on my bed under the pillow and now the pillow is smoking and has a small flame on it!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! I walked into the kitchen and there is a very strong smell of gas and a loud hissing sound coming from the LPG tank under the stove!

scenarios.title: Dry Cogon Grass Fire
scenarios.location: Luna Extension, Brgy. Sto. Angel Norte

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! The dry cogon grass in the empty lot next to our house caught fire, and the wind is blowing the flames toward our wooden fence!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My grandmother cleaned the wood stove (pugon) and put the hot ashes in a cardboard box outside. Now the box is burning and starting to catch the wooden wall!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hi! We have a power strip extension cord in the living room with the TV, fan, and phone charger all plugged in. It started sparking and now the plastic is melting and catching fire on the rug!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! I was lighting birthday candles in my bedroom and one knocked over onto a pile of paper decorations on my desk! Now the desk is on fire!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! My laptop was charging on the bed, and it suddenly made a pop sound and started hissing! Now thick grey smoke and sparks are shooting out of the keyboard!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My sister was frying eggrolls and hot oil splashed out, catching a dry cloth towel next to the stove on fire! The stove counter is burning!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! The internet router on our bookshelf started buzzing and now thick white smoke and sparks are shooting out! It's right next to a stack of books!

scenarios.title: Siga Yard Fire Spreads
scenarios.location: P. Burgos Street, Brgy. Poblacion I

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! The burning leaves (siga) in our backyard got out of control because of the wind and caught the dry clothes hanging on our laundry line on fire! The line is falling toward the wooden chicken coop!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello? I left a burning candle on the plastic bathroom shelf and now the shelf has melted and caught fire! The plastic bottles are burning and releasing black smoke!

scenarios.title: Hair Iron Left on Mattress
scenarios.location: Luna Extension, Brgy. Sto. Angel Norte

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My sister left her hot hair straightener flat iron turned on and resting on the bed mattress! Now the mattress is smoking and has a small flame!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! My brother was playing with matches under the mosquito net (kulambo) and the net caught fire! It burned really fast and now the bedsheet is on fire!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! A pile of burning leaves in our neighbor's yard is spreading to our dry bamboo fence! The fence is catching fire and it's close to our house wooden wall!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My brother left the clothing iron face down on the ironing board in the laundry room! Now the shirt and the board cover are smoking and catching fire!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My sister left an insect spray can on the counter right next to the hot stove burner. The can is making a hissing sound and starting to bulge!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! A burning candle in a plastic cup melted through the plastic and ignited the wooden table cover! The table is on fire!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! My brother left a burning mosquito coil under the bed and it ignited a cardboard box full of old toys! The box is burning and smoke is coming from under the bed!

scenarios.title: Overheated Rice Cooker Plug
scenarios.location: P. Burgos Street, Brgy. Poblacion I

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! The rice cooker plug in our kitchen is sparking and making a buzzing noise, and now the plastic wall outlet is melting and catching fire!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! My brother threw a match he thought was extinguished into the plastic trash bin in the living room. Now the trash bin is fully on fire and melting!

scenarios.title: Bookshelf Mosquito Coil Fire
scenarios.location: Luna Extension, Brgy. Sto. Angel Norte

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! A mosquito coil left burning on our wooden bookshelf ignited a stack of papers and a notebook. Now the shelf is on fire and making a lot of smoke!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My sister was frying chicken and hot oil splattered out, catching a paper bag next to the stove on fire! The counter is burning!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! My brother left his laptop charger block covered by a blanket on the bed. Now the block is melting and the bedsheet is smoking and has a small flame!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! I am at the park and I found a very small toddler, maybe 3 years old, crying and walking alone near the fountain. I don't see any parents around!

scenarios.title: Suspicious Vehicle Following
scenarios.location: Town Plaza Alley, Brgy. Poblacion III

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! I am walking home from school and there is a black van with dark windows driving very slowly right behind me. Every time I cross the street, the van crosses too!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! I am at the park playground and a group of older teenagers are surrounding a younger boy, shoving him and shouting at him. It looks like they are going to hit him!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! I am standing outside my house and I noticed my neighbor's front gate is wide open and their metal padlock is lying broken on the driveway! They are away on vacation!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! Me and my older sister were walking in the market and a man ran past, snatched her phone right out of her hand, and ran toward the jeepney terminal!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! I am calling from my sister's phone. I got separated from my parents inside the crowded supermarket and I can't find them anywhere! I am scared.

scenarios.title: Illegal Dumping in Lot
scenarios.location: Municipal Hall Annex, Brgy. Poblacion I

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! I am looking out my window and there is a small blue truck parked in the empty grassy lot next to our house. Two men are dumping big bags of stinky trash and old plastic drums there!

scenarios.title: Park Bench Vandalism
scenarios.location: Public Market Parking Area, Brgy. Poblacion IV

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! I am at the playground and three older kids are spray-painting graffiti all over the new swings and breaking the wooden slats on the park benches!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! I am at the plaza and there is a large, heavy-looking backpack left on a bench near the bandstand. It has been sitting here for over an hour and nobody is around!

scenarios.title: Low Flying Drone Backyard
scenarios.location: Town Plaza Alley, Brgy. Poblacion III

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! There is a small black drone with flashing lights flying very low over our backyard. It keeps hovering right outside my bedroom window and recording!

scenarios.title: Bicycle Road Scrape
scenarios.location: Old Market Road, Brgy. Poblacion IV

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My brother fell off his bicycle onto the asphalt road. He has a large, dirty scrape on his knee that is bleeding a lot and he is crying in pain!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My sister was frying fish and hot oil splattered onto her forearm. It is very red and she is crying because it hurts so much!

scenarios.title: Nosebleed from Playing
scenarios.location: Bus Terminal Loading Bay, Brgy. Bubukal

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My brother was playing tag outside in the hot sun and his nose suddenly started bleeding very heavily! The blood is dropping all over his shirt!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hi! My brother jumped off the low garden wall and landed badly on his foot. His ankle is swelling up very quickly, he cannot stand, and he is crying!

scenarios.title: Stray Cat Scratch
scenarios.location: Barangay San Juan (Near the health center)

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My sister was playing with a stray cat outside and the cat got scared and scratched her arm. It is bleeding slightly and she is crying!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My brother was sweeping the dusty old storeroom and started coughing really heavily. Now he is coughing continuously, struggling to catch his breath, and his chest feels tight!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My brother cut his finger on a sharp piece of broken plastic from his toy. It is bleeding and he is crying because it hurts!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My sister spent all afternoon playing at the beach without sunscreen. Now her shoulders are extremely red, hot, and peeling, and she is crying because it hurts when clothes touch her skin!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My brother was playing in the garden and got stung by a bee on his arm. The stinger is still stuck in his skin and the area is turning red and swelling!

scenarios.title: Toy Bead Stuck in Ear
scenarios.location: Old Market Road, Brgy. Poblacion IV

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My little brother was playing with some crafts and put a small round plastic bead inside his ear! Now it is stuck deep inside and he is crying because it feels blocked!

scenarios.title: Earthquake Shelf Collapse and Fire
scenarios.location: Town Plaza Alley, Brgy. Poblacion III

transcript.text: 911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! We just had a strong earthquake tremor! The tall bookshelf in the living room fell over, pinning my brother's leg underneath, and now a fallen desk lamp is sparking and catching the rug on fire!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! My brother was riding his bike on the side of the road when a speeding motorcycle hit him and drove off without stopping! My brother is lying on the grass, his leg is bleeding, and he can't get up!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! A grass fire in the empty field next to our street has spread to the wooden power pole! The pole is catching fire and the overhead wires are starting to spark and sag!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello! I am at the small grocery store and a man just snatched cash from the register and ran out the door! The elderly lady clerk got so scared that she fainted and hit her head on the counter!
911, what is your emergency?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Help! A fallen tree branch snapped the low utility line on our street. The wire is sparking on our bamboo fence, catching the fence on fire, and the live wire is blocking our driveway!
